messages:
oliver: Hey folks, my Okta invite says 'This token has expired' when I try to finish SSO/MFA. Tried the invite link from the onboarding email twice — anyone able to regen?

sasha: @oliver sorry about that — can you confirm the email you used? I'll resend from Okta. Also try incognito and check spam.

oliver: it's oliver@redwood.com. Exact error: 'INV-ERR-EXPIRED: token expired (code 410)'. I attached a screenshot of the browser page.

devon: FYI we had a small invite-sweep yesterday where some tokens were mailed with 24h expiry; people-ops fixed the cron but a few invites need manual regen. If you need immediate access, request a temporary access lift at https://redwood.example/internal/temps-lift — that bypass lasts 2 hours.

sasha: regen'd and resent a new Okta invite to oliver@redwood.com just now. Should arrive in ~2–3 mins. Steps once it arrives: open 'Activate account' -> set password -> enroll MFA (use Google Authenticator or 1Password TOTP). If you're on Linux, try incognito and disable extensions like uBlock.

onboard-bot: Heads up: 1Password invite is a separate email from 1password-invite@redwood.com. If you don't see it, file a request at https://redwood.example/internal/1p-help. For SSH access, paste your public key here or run `cat ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub` and paste output.

oliver: got the new invite and completed SSO flow — enrolled with Google Authenticator. 1Password invite just arrived too. Also pasting pubkey per above: `ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAIExampleKey oliver@laptop`. Thanks everyone! :tada:

sasha: Awesome — welcome aboard! I've added you to the #eng team group; ping here if any repos are missing.

devon: Added you to the dev access list. If you need sudo on CI hosts, DM me and I'll open the request.
